newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank in talks with Scottish Widows.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank in talks with Scottish Widows.

text.p: Royal Bank of Scotland Group Plc and mutually-owned life insurer Scottish Widows said on Thursday they are in talks about cooperating in a number of areas.

The groups said in a statement they expect that Scottish Widows will provide administration services for Royal Bank's life insurance subsidiary, Royal Scottish Assurance (RSA), and will purchase a stake in RSA.

Scottish Widows will also contribute to the future development of Royal Bank's telephone insurance unit Direct Line Life as a shared joint venture. In future, the two companies will consider other opportunities for working together.

George Mathewson, Chief Executive of Royal Bank Group, said, "Royal Scottish Assurance and Direct Line Life are businesses with great potential and Scottish Widows has all the qualities to help us achieve our ambitions fully.
"In addition, I believe that there are a number of areas in which we can assist Scottish Widows and we look forward to working together in the years ahead," he said.
